card: Removes unused helper methods GetNetMsg and PushNetMsg from the DynSock::Pipe test utility, along with associated condition variable synchronization. The methods were originally introduced in PR #30205 to prepare for PR #26812, which was never merged. This is routine dead code removal in the test utility suite.
changed_since_previous: Diff provided; confirms removal of unused test helper methods and associated condition variable synchronization.
evidence: PR description: 'This was merged as part of #30205, in advance of #26812, which never landed.'
problem: Dead helper code and associated condition-variable synchronization remain in the test socket utilities after being merged in PR #30205 for PR #26812, which was never merged.

risk.why: Only touches test socket utility code, so any issue would at most cause unit test failures rather than affect production nodes.

summary: Removes the unused `DynSock::Pipe::GetNetMsg` and `PushNetMsg` helper methods from the test framework. Also removes the now-unneeded `WaitForDataOrEof` method and the pipe's internal condition variable, changing `DynSock::Pipe::GetBytes` to acquire a normal mutex lock.
